cases.name: Camera defaults denied; explicit main-app approval enables video only
SSO popups, callbacks, frames and lookalike origins cannot request or reuse grant
Denial and concurrent requests settle once without persisting a grant
Revoke, replacement/failure and renderer destruction reject pending consent
Navigating to sign-in or another document invalidates old and pending grants
Trusted bundled and exact development renderers use consent; reset revokes without losing records
Only trusted main frames may copy sanitized text; clipboard reads and popup/frame writes stay denied

limits: Policy checks do not exercise actual OS/device permissions; see separate Electron runtime qualification
